source.title: Frontier Sentinel, 13 May 1939, p. 5 ("New member for Glenn")
source.publisher: Frontier Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations from the Frontier Sentinel (6 May 1939, p. 5); Glen return from the Frontier Sentinel (13 May 1939, p. 5).

note: Triennial election, polled at the end of May 1939. There were no contests: twelve divisions were filled by nomination or by the retiring member continuing where no nomination was received. Filed on 1939-06-01, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1939-05-31 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Edward John Convery (N.) withdrew, leaving M'Anulty returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
